name: little-coder
description: Coding agent tuned for small local models, built from the Pi harness plus a bundle of extensions and skills.
whatItDoes: little-coder makes agentic coding practical on modest hardware by adapting the workflow to small models. It runs against llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio and can also use cloud models. It is for developers who want a private, offline-capable coding helper.
howItWorks: The project packages Pi with roughly thirty extensions and a set of skills that compensate for the limits of small models. The model is picked with a command-line flag, and cloud providers are enabled through environment variables.

requirements.name: Local model server
requirements.description: llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio for local inference

models: Small local models via llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio; cloud models optional
